blocks.text: In the ever-shifting, high-stakes world of modern Hollywood, leadership transitions are often greeted with equal parts skepticism and fanfare. Yet, when Skydance Motion Picture Group officially announced that veteran producer Jeremy Latcham will step into the roles of president and Chief Creative Officer of DC Studios on December 1, 2026, something remarkable happened across the entertainment landscape: the collective sigh of relief from lifelong comic book readers, moviegoers, and industry observers was practically deafening. Back on December 8, 2025, in my entertainment column titled “Is James Gunn the right man to continue to helm the entire DC Universe?”, I posed a […]...
